powers.name: Rusting Touch
powers.summary: Make a melee touch attack against a carried or worn metal item. It takes 1d6 + half Druid level damage, bypassing hardness when nonmagical or when your caster level exceeds the item's caster level. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Erosion Aura
powers.summary: As a standard action, reduce metal and stone hardness by 10 in an aura; magic items retain at least twice their enhancement bonus and may save. Metal or stone constructs save or lose DR and hardness for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Vermin Whisperer
powers.summary: Use wild empathy on mindless vermin or vermin with Intelligence 2 or lower, interacting with them as though they were animals.

powers.name: Sudden Sting
powers.summary: As a swift action, make a melee touch attack for 1d4 piercing damage + 1 per 2 Druid levels; Fortitude negates staggered for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

domainSpells.name: summon nature's ally IX (1d3 purple worms only)
